Package com.neueda.leap.order.model

Class HoldingMovement

java.lang.Object
com.neueda.leap.order.model.HoldingMovement
@Entity public class HoldingMovement extends Object
HoldingMovement entity for append-only ledger of quantity changes. BR-09, BR-10: Append-only ledger where every fill creates an immutable movement record. Source of truth for holdings: holdings table is computed cache. BR-15: Enables reconstruction of any account state from ledger.
